name: Product review sentiment
description: Sentiment as a 5-level score plus a sarcasm check. Mixed and sarcastic reviews are the interesting ones. Pick a review from the input sets (gushing, sarcastic, mixed, flat) or paste your own.

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of `review` towards the product?
criteria: Very negative: would warn others away

sarcastic.instructions: Is `review` sarcastic, i.e. does its literal wording mean the opposite of what the writer intends?

wouldBuyAgain.instructions: Does the writer of `review` indicate they would buy this product again?
